alive.last_commit_message:
fix(remote): scan hf:// model files in subfolders and on every listing page (#125)

The Hugging Face tree listing was requested without recursive=true and only its first page was read, so supported files under any folder (onnx/, unet/, text_encoder/, ...) were skipped silently. A repo with all of its weights in subfolders scanned as 'No AI models found' and exited 0.

- List recursively and follow the Link next cursor, up to 100 pages. A failure on any page propagates; a next link off huggingface.co is refused because the token rides on every page; a non-list page is an error.
- Skip directory entries and percent-encode paths in resolve URLs.
- Name hf:// components by repo-relative path so same-named files in different folders no longer collide. Root-level files keep their bare names.
- A listing that stops at the page cap still scans what it listed, then records a ListingTruncated target error so the scan exits 1.

Verified old-vs-new on all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (3 -> 14 components), bert-base-uncased (4 -> 5) and tiny-stable-diffusion-pipe (0 -> 4): additive only, no existing component changed.
